title: sdlc-supervisor project.yaml
description: Project policy for the sdlc-supervisor framework: framework/schema version, run budgets (design-spec.md §7), verification-profile floor (design-spec.md §6), and the bootstrap owned-files list. Authored as YAML on disk (.sdlc/project.yaml); this schema describes its parsed (JSON-equivalent) shape.

framework_version.description: Version of the sdlc-supervisor framework itself (the orchestrator/agent/hook machinery), independent of any one schema's shape.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema's shape (semver) -- should track docs/sdlc/schemas/project.schema.json, and does not need to move in lockstep with state.schema.json's schema_version.

budgets.description: Run budgets from design-spec.md §7. All but token_or_time_budget are hard caps enforced by the orchestrator; token_or_time_budget is explicitly soft (logged and flagged, not a hard kill).

max_tasks_per_run.description: Maximum number of tasks the orchestrator will drive to completion in a single run before stopping. Default used in this project's example: 5 -- small enough that a run staying within one phase of docs/sdlc/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md is normal, not a limiter.

max_concurrent_implementers.description: Maximum number of implementer agents the orchestrator may have leased/running at once. Default used in this project's example: 1 -- this project has no parallel-safe task pairs yet (see the dependency graph in .sdlc/state.json), so concurrency isn't yet useful and raising it before it is would just add coordination risk.

max_attempts_per_task.description: Maximum attempts an implementer may make on one task (tracked via that task's lease.attempt_count in state.json) before the task escalates to the orchestrator instead of being retried automatically. Default used in this project's example: 3.

max_verifier_retries.description: Maximum times a Verifier subagent (design-spec.md §6) may be re-run on the same task/report before escalating. Default used in this project's example: 2.

token_or_time_budget.description: Soft, per-run budget -- logged and flagged when exceeded, never used to hard-kill a run. Either field (or both) may be null to mean 'not tracked'.

tokens.description: Rough token budget for a run. null = not tracked. No default enforced by this schema; this project's example leaves it null pending real usage data from dogfooding (SS6.1).

minutes.description: Rough wall-clock time budget for a run, in minutes. null = not tracked. Default used in this project's example: 120.

verification_profile.description: Strong verification (a separate read-only Verifier subagent, design-spec.md §6) is required, not optional, for any task packet touching floor_triggers. A project may widen that list; it cannot narrow it.

floor_triggers.description: Fixed floor from design-spec.md §6. This exact set is immutable framework policy -- a conforming project.yaml MUST reproduce it verbatim here (do not edit; widen coverage via the `widen` array instead).

widen.description: Project-specific additional triggers (free-form strings or path/description patterns) that also require strong verification for this project, on top of the immutable floor. May be empty.

owned_files.description: Path globs this project's sdlc tooling considers itself the owner/bootstrapper of -- used by tooling (e.g. the future sdlc-doctor command, SS5.1) to know what it's safe to scaffold, check, or regenerate without being told file-by-file.
